_template.label: EMAI Starter
_template.description: PARA-style personal workspace: Human (tasks, projects, areas, resources, people, daily, reviews), Content (videos, briefs, calendar, research), and Machine (workflows, SOPs, agents, code, skills). Schema-driven; brings its own entity definitions.

bases.Content.base:
filters:
  and:
    - note.type == "content-event"
formulas:
  open: link(file.path, "🔍")
properties:
  file.name:
    displayName: Content
  note.status:
    displayName: Status
  note.content_stage:
    displayName: Stage
  note.platform:
    displayName: Platform
  note.channel:
    displayName: Channel
  note.format:
    displayName: Format
  note.priority:
    displayName: Priority
  note.date:
    displayName: Date
  note.end_date:
    displayName: End
views:
  - type: cards
    name: Pipeline
    groupBy:
      property: content_stage
      direction: ASC
    order:
      - formula.open
      - file.name
      - status
      - platform
      - format
      - priority
      - date
    sort:
      - property: date
        direction: ASC
    columnSize:
      formula.open: 52
  - type: table
    name: Calendar
    order:
      - formula.open
      - file.name
      - date
      - content_stage
      - status
      - platform
      - channel
      - format
      - priority
    sort:
      - property: date
        direction: ASC
    columnSize:
      formula.open: 52
bases.Inbox.base:
filters:
  and:
    - note.type == "inbox"
formulas:
  open: link(file.path, "🔍")
properties:

    displayName: Capture
  note.status:

  note.captured:
    displayName: Captured
  note.capture_source:
    displayName: Source
  note.triage_target:
    displayName: Triage To
views:

    name: Triage
    order:
      - formula.open
      - file.name
      - status
      - captured
      - capture_source
      - triage_target
    sort:
      - property: captured
        direction: DESC
    columnSize:
      formula.open: 52
  - type: cards
    name: By Status
    groupBy:
      property: status
      direction: ASC
    order:
      - formula.open
      - file.name
      - captured
      - capture_source
    sort:
      - property: captured
        direction: DESC
    columnSize:
      formula.open: 52

bases.Tasks.base:

properties:

    displayName: Task
  note.status:

  note.project:
    displayName: Project
  note.area:
    displayName: Area
  note.due_date:
    displayName: Due
  note.date_added:
    displayName: Added
  note.date_completed:
    displayName: Completed
views:
  - type: cards
    name: Board
    groupBy:

      direction: ASC
    order:

      - project
      - area
      - due_date
    sort:

        direction: ASC
    columnSize:

  - type: table
    name: Open
    filters:

        - note.status != "done"
        - note.status != "archived"
    order:
      - formula.open
      - file.name
      - status
      - project
      - area
      - due_date
    sort:

    columnSize:

  - type: table

      - due_date
      - date_added

    sort:

        direction: DESC
    columnSize:
      formula.open: 52
